title: The teachers' handout prints on one page again
items: Guide › For teachers prints its handout on a single sheet again, at Letter and at A4. Since 1871 gained its own Jaunts there are twelve suggestions, and the last one was running onto a second page. The four destinations now print two by two, 1835 beside 1904 and 1812 beside 1871, under the ten Field Check steps.
